name: Whispered Scrolls
summary:
Whispered Scrolls is a free fantasy MMORPG that you can also play in your web browser. Long ago the world of Aethermere was written into being on a set of scrolls. Those scrolls were shattered, and now they've begun to whisper again.

You train a wide variety of skills from level 1 to 99, covering combat, utility, gathering and crafting, so you can mine ore, smith your own armor, fish, cook and enchant. Combat is real-time and third person with no tab-targeting, across 21 weapon types: you aim every swing, arrow and spell yourself, block and parry on reaction, and dodge-roll out of telegraphed attacks. Team up in parties of up to five players with tank, healer and damage roles to take on dungeons and multi-phase bosses, follow a main story across 20 towns, trade with other players at the market, and share one living world with everyone online.
